I'm really sorry to hear about the trouble you've had with your orders. I completely understand why you're upset. As customer support, it's my duty to help resolve this issue for you.

To get a better understanding of what happened, could you please provide me with the order numbers for the books that haven't arrived? That way, I can track their progress and determine the cause of the delay.

conversation: Can you also tell me what's on order B1002?
results.final_response: I'm sorry, I don’t have direct access to order details. But, you may check your order status and details on the 'My Orders' section of our website/app. Alternatively, you can also reach out to the seller directly to inquire about your order. They are in the best position to give you the most accurate update about what's on your specific order.

Our return policy is that you can return any item within 30 days of receiving your order. However, the items must be in the same condition you received them, unused and in their original packaging. If your return is approved, we will initiate a refund to your original payment method. Please note that shipping costs are non-refundable. Please let me know if you have any other questions.
